titleText.es: Espera, maldita sea, creo que he visto un email nuevo en el último refresco.
titleText.en: Wait, damn it, I think I saw a new email on the last refresh.
titleText.noteEn: Refresco refers to reloading the inbox to check for newly arrived mail.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: to refresh; to reload (a page or inbox)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Refrescar can literally mean to cool or refresh something. In a computer context, it means reloading a page or checking it for updated content.

example.es: Refresca la página para ver los cambios.
example.en: Refresh the page to see the changes.
